content: धातृ {%m.%} [धा-तृच्] .²1 A maker, creator, originator, author. .²2 A bearer, preserver, supporter. .²3 An epithet of Brahmā, the creator of the world; मन्ये दुर्जनचित्तवृत्तिहरणे धातापि भग्नोद्यमः <ls>H. 2. 124</ls>; <ls>R. 13. 6</ls>; <ls>Śi. 1. 13</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 44</ls>; <ls>Ki. 12. 33</ls>; सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ धाता यथापूर्वमकल्पयत् . <ls>Mahānār. Up.</ls> .²4 An epithet of Viṣṇu; <ls>Mb. 12. 15. 18</ls>. .²5 The soul. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> for the seven sages (सप्तर्षि) being the first creation of Brahmā; <ab>cf.</ab> पुरातनाः पुराविद्भिर्धातार इति कीर्तिताः <ls>Ku. 6. 9</ls>. .²7 A married womanʼs paramour, adulterer. .²8 One of the forty-nine winds. .²9 An arranger. .²10 One who nourishes. .²11 A star among ध्रुवमत्स्य; <ls>Bhāg. 5. 23. 5</ls>. .²12 Fate, destiny; धाता यथा मां विदधीत लोके ध्रुवं तथाऽहं भवितेति मत्वा <ls>Mb. 1. 89. 10</ls>.
